name: Counter relay with manual reset
summary: A manually reset counter relay records qualifying events and retains a count until the documented reset action.
description: A manually reset counter relay records qualifying events and retains a count until the documented reset action. Event input, count condition and reset control should be identifiable on the drawing.
readingNotes: Count events at the configured input rather than assuming every power cycle is an event.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A counter accumulates events; a timer measures duration.
